visual.evaluation_instructions:
Check for the following:

- Is the button in disabled state
- Is the message present to tell the user that they have reached max attempts
- Is the countdown visible
- Is the formatting of the message such that it looks like warning/error

criteria: The background should exactly be the same
The keyboard should be present and look exactly the same
Any buttons should look the same. However, in disabled state the color can be different
The error message block should look visually similar to the "OTP expired" block
The padding, spacing, etc should match
